Introduction

Aschenputtel, also known as Cinderella, is a classic fairy tale about a kind and beautiful girl who is mistreated by her stepmother and stepdaughters. Despite her hardships, she remains kind-hearted and eventually finds happiness through the help of magical beings and her own perseverance.
